receiptBody: Payment of {amount} received for invoice {number}. Thank you.
failedBody:
The payment for invoice {number} could not be collected. Pay this invoice: {payUrl}
Update your saved card: {updateUrl}
actionBody:
Your bank requires authentication for invoice {number}. Complete payment: {payUrl}
Update your saved card: {updateUrl}
duplicateBody: An additional card payment of {amount} arrived for invoice {number}, which was already paid. An automatic refund was queued. Check the refund status in billing.
refundFailedBody: A refund of {amount} for invoice {number} failed or was canceled, so the payer did not receive it. Check the payment and its refunds in billing, and refund the payer another way only if they are still owed.
refundReversedBody: A refund of {amount} for invoice {number} was reported as successful but then failed, so the payer did not receive it. Check the payment in billing and refund the payer another way.
